transcript.text: Alright everyone, let's get this final production meeting started. We've got the draft plan for the video recording of the September 18 show at the Orpheum — four stagehands on a four-hour crew call, for internal archive purposes. Before I can approve it, I need the artist liaison and labor coordinator to confirm their respective areas. So, what are we hearing?

transcript.text: I need to flag a restriction on the draft plan. I received the artist's signed performance rider this morning. The rider permits an audio-only archival recording, prohibits any video recording, and requires the archive credit to read exactly 'Live at the Orpheum — The Juniper Set'. I have not yet attached the rider to the production file.
